name: cucumber
description: Reusable native Rust BDD foundation, extensible SDK, TypeScript/Python FFI and coordinated Gherkin documentation/contribution work.

folders.purpose: Core, SDK, bindings and Cucumber documentation
Maintained parser fork, Gherkin documentation and ordered upstream contribution

commandPolicy.verification: Only the adopted finite BDD packet after complete production at B4; affected repair packet at authorized B5.
commandPolicy.toolchain: Preserve installed Cargo config; Rust1.88 is the declared core minimum. No generic check/test/lint defaults.
commandPolicy.release: No registry registration/publication or documentation deployment pending names/ownership/hosting decisions.
commandPolicy.repositoryPreservation: Commit and push authorized to verified GQAdonis origins; preserve established main/v-tag workflows and avoid their release/deploy triggers.

historicalCheckpoint.scope: through45 historical BDD, not retroactively KBD-certified
